items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: This is what Eddie told me.

ctx.x: Yeah. Everybody thought Monk was late but Monk. This is what Eddie told me. He says, Monk has a job, it's his job, when he come to work and somebody would be playing piano, so he'd go out two or three hours and come back. He said that when Monk was coming to the Five Spot, to him it was the same as me and ______, expect somebody to be there playing in his place.
